title: Titanium SSD Armor Enclosure
function: Solid state drive lightweight armor enclosure case
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (Grade 5, UNS R56400) was selected for this storage hardware application because its 900+ MPa tensile enables thin-wall lightweighting under cyclic loading. The alpha-beta microstructure provides 45% higher specific strength than 4140 steel, critical for weight-sensitive designs. Its 6.7 W/mK thermal conductivity simplifies thermal management. This rationale is driven by solid state drive lightweight armor enclosure case and fat life requirements.
process: CNC milling HSM 30k RPM for storage hardware geometry
surfaceTreatment: PVD TiAlN coating (2-3um, HV2500 hardness) for scratch resistance and uniform gunmetal aesthetic finish
commonFailures: Anodic color shift DE >2.0 from inconsistent bath temp - requires ±1C electrolyte control during PVD

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium SSD Armor Enclosure suitable for Solid state drive lightweight armor enclosure case?
faq.a: Titanium SSD Armor Enclosure uses Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address storage hardware operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium SSD Armor Enclosure?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium SSD Armor Enclosure require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. storage hardware components receive PVD TiAlN coating (2-3um, HV2500 hardness) for scratch resistance and uniform gunmetal aesthetic finish. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the service environment.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium SSD Armor Enclosure shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements; (4) Surface roughness certification on critical features. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for SSD case / Drive enclosure storage hardware components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
